name: acc_cp2_node_loss_recovery
description: Acceptance fixture (hash-frozen, NOT included in CP-1 totals): node-loss recovery under CP-2. A trial enters RUNNING, then loses its resources (simulated as a fast finish/failure). The CP-2 controller releases the parent PG, requeues the trial, and replans — the trial completes with a single safe retry. Under FIFO the same scenario ends in FAILED because no retry logic exists.
